# scrutari Provider

The Scrutari provider manages routing, API keys, and other resources on a Scrutari post-quantum gateway via the public REST API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Scoped API key minted via `POST /v1/api_keys` or the dashboard. Must start with `scru_live_` or `scru_test_`. May also be set via the `SCRUTARI_API_KEY` env var (recommended — keeps secrets out of `.tf` files).
- `host` (String) Base URL of the Scrutari gateway's control-plane API. May also be set via the `SCRUTARI_HOST` env var. Defaults to `https://api.edge.scrutari.ai` when unset.
